transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer technical support. My name is Megan. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Megan. I'm calling about our S-Net 4K TV Box. Whenever we try to launch the BBC iPlayer or Netflix apps from the main menu, the screen freezes on a black screen with a spinning white circle and completely crashes the box. I already power-cycled the TV box twice from the wall switch this morning, but it still crashes every time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you troubleshoot those application crashes, Gareth. Can you please confirm the equipment serial number printed on the white label under your TV box?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the serial number is TV-991-4402.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Gareth. And what television set brand is the box connected to via HDMI?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is connected to a 55-inch LG OLED TV. My wife is bedridden recovering from major knee replacement surgery this week, and watching her period dramas on BBC iPlayer is literally her only entertainment and distraction from severe surgical pain! Having the TV box crash every time she tries to watch television is causing her massive frustration!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how important that television entertainment is for your wife's recovery after knee surgery, Gareth. Having the streaming applications freeze when she needs distraction from post-operative pain is extremely frustrating, so let us troubleshoot the application runtime data and get her shows playing smoothly right away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Megan, that means a lot to us.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your S-Net 4K TV box freezes on a black screen and crashes whenever launching BBC iPlayer or Netflix despite multiple power-cycles, and you need the streaming software restored so your wife can comfortably watch her programmes. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what we need to get sorted today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Third-party streaming applications like BBC iPlayer and Netflix are written by outside corporations; S-Net has no responsibility for software bugs or crashes in third-party code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, the apps come pre-installed on the S-Net TV box that we pay ten pounds a month for! S-Net should make sure the box runs them properly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our contract guarantees hardware transport of linear broadcast channels; external streaming apps are subject to their respective developer terms.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we still fix the freezing issue?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, this crash typically occurs when an application's cached user session tokens become corrupted following an automatic app update.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do we clear that corrupted cached data?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take your S-Net TV remote control, press the Home button, and navigate to the Settings gear icon in the top right corner.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressing Home... navigating to Settings gear icon. I am in the main System Settings menu.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Scroll down to 'Applications and Storage', and press OK.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Applications and Storage... pressing OK. I see a list of installed apps: BBC iPlayer, Netflix, ITVX, Channel 4, and YouTube.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Highlight BBC iPlayer, press OK, select 'Force Stop', and then select 'Clear Cache and Data'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Highlighting BBC iPlayer... Force Stop... Clear Cache and Data. A prompt asked to confirm deleting temporary application files... pressing Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The box has purged the stale flash storage cache. Now do the exact same procedure for Netflix: Force Stop, and Clear Cache.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selecting Netflix... Force Stop... Clear Cache. Both applications have had their cached storage wiped clean.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now press the Back button to return to Settings, scroll down to 'System Software Update', and select 'Check for Updates'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking for Updates... it says 'Application Runtime Update v4.18 available - 42 megabytes'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Select 'Update Now'. This patch updates the underlying WebKit HTML5 container engine that hosts the streaming applications.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Clicking Update Now... download progress bar is moving... 60%... 100%. Screen says 'Update applied successfully, restart required'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Select 'Restart Box Now'. The box will perform a clean software reload.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Restarting now... the S-Net logo has appeared on the LG TV screen... home screen has loaded cleanly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now navigate to BBC iPlayer and launch the application.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selecting BBC iPlayer... pressing OK. The BBC iPlayer logo loaded in three seconds and the main programme carousel appeared without freezing!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Select one of your wife's drama series to confirm video playback throughput.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selecting Call the Midwife... clicking Play. High definition video and crystal clear sound started instantly! No spinning circle at all!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms the WebKit rendering container was successfully re-initialized by clearing corrupt session cache, Gareth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now let me press Home and test Netflix as well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead, verify Netflix launch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Launching Netflix... profile selection screen appeared instantly! Selected my profile and the top menu loaded flawlessly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Both streaming applications are fully restored.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My wife will be thrilled to bits.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you tried power-cycling the TV box from the mains wall switch to see if that helps?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Megan, as I told you in my very first sentence, I already power-cycled the box twice this morning before calling you! And besides, we just fixed the issue by updating the software!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, Gareth, that was a standard procedural script question on my troubleshooting flow.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, please listen to what customers say so you don't repeat unnecessary questions.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Let us check the HDMI CEC control setting on your TV box so your remote turns on both devices together.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where is that HDMI setting?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under Settings, Display and Audio, toggle 'One-Touch Play HDMI-CEC' to ON.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Toggling One-Touch Play to ON. Done.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That enables the S-Net remote to control the volume on your LG television directly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very handy for my wife from bed so she only needs one remote control.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the display resolution format under Display and Audio to verify it is matched to your 4K OLED screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Display Resolution is currently set to 1080p Automatic. Should we switch it to 4K UHD 60Hz?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Select 4K UHD 60Hz with HDR10 enabled; your LG OLED will automatically decode high dynamic range colour spaces.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selecting 4K 60Hz HDR10... the TV screen flickered once and the 'HDR' badge popped up in the corner! The picture is breathtakingly sharp!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The HDMI handshake has synchronized at eighteen gigabits per second bandwidth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about the accessibility subtitle settings for my wife?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under Accessibility, toggle 'Subtitles Always On' so dialogue text displays automatically across all streaming apps.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Toggling Subtitles to ON. That will make it so much easier for her while resting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the standby timer options so the TV box does not shut down automatically in the middle of long television films.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Under Power Management, Auto-Standby is currently set to four hours. Should we increase that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Setting Auto-Standby to eight hours ensures her programmes will not cut out if she rests without pressing buttons.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selected eight hours. That is much better for someone resting in bed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your internet connection speed test from the TV box's built-in network diagnostic menu.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Under Network Diagnostics, clicking Run Speed Test... it shows ninety-four megabits per second download over Ethernet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ninety-four megabits provides ample bandwidth for multiple concurrent 4K Ultra HD streams without buffering.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is plenty fast enough for her programmes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Check the Remote Control menu to ensure the Bluetooth remote battery is above fifty percent.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Remote battery level displays eighty-eight percent, so that is in great shape.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If these applications crash again in future, do not call S-Net support as we do not provide software maintenance for third-party streaming apps.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, who am I supposed to call if the apps on your box fail? BBC doesn't have a phone line for TV box app support!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can visit the BBC iPlayer online help website. S-Net's obligation is strictly hardware connectivity.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That feels like passing the buck, Megan. But at least you helped us clear the cache today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Could you also check our broadband speed to make sure 4K streaming won't buffer when...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your speed is fine and the apps are working. Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, Megan, don't hang up... hello? She hung up on me!
